text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The report recommends expanding the Free-Floating Car-Share Program operating area into a portion of Ward 20, consistent with the expansion framework approved by City Council in October 2025. The expansion was requested by the City's sole active free-floating car-share operator in response to observed demand and has been developed in consultation with City staff and the local Ward Councillor. If approved, free-floating car-share vehicles operating under a valid permit would be exempt from the City-wide three-hour unsigned parking limit and parking regulations imposing maximum parking periods of one hour or more within the approved expansion area. Amended Schedule XLVIII, Parts 1 and 2, of Chapter 950, Traffic and Parking, of the City of Toronto Municipal Code, generally as described in Attachment 1 to the report (June 17, 2026) from the Acting Director, Street Permits, Transportation Services, to expand the Free-Floating Car-Share Program operating area into the portion of Ward 20 identified in Attachment 1 to the report (June 17, 2026) from the Acting Director, Street Permits, Transportation Services.
